prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: complete panoramic background for an original cheerful fantasy match-3 battle game.
Input image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the polished smooth cartoon 3D rendering, bright palette and rounded fairytale forms. Create an entirely original courtyard; do not reproduce its characters, branding, text or layout.
Primary request: A wide 2:1 landscape image, requested 2048x1024 pixels. A sunny fairytale palace courtyard with lush rounded greenery, rounded golden stone towers and blue roofs, turquoise-blue sky and a spacious clean pale stone battle platform across the lower half. Warm inviting atmosphere, playful proportions, soft bevels and beautiful glossy toy-like surfaces.
Composition: eye-level view across the courtyard, palace architecture and trees framing the back and sides, clear wide empty paving foreground from left to right for separate combat characters. Open space at lower left and lower right; simple readable depth. Soft sunny light and ambient occlusion; polished animated-film quality, strongly volumetric rather than a flat illustration.
Constraints: only architecture, greenery, sky and paving. No characters, creatures, vehicles, letters, logos, numbers, interface, watermark or text. Full finished scene with an opaque background.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original cartoon 3D character action sprite atlas.
Input image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Use the same broad visual language of glossy smooth rounded cartoon 3D, bright polished mobile-game materials and big expressive friendly faces. Do not recreate any character, logo or branding from the reference.
Primary request: exactly TWELVE separated full-body pose sprites in a precise regular THREE-COLUMN by FOUR-ROW grid. Portrait canvas 3:4 aspect, requested 1536x2048 pixels, twelve equal square 512x512 cells. Never draw cell lines or labels.
TOP TWO ROWS: the SAME original friendly ginger-haired knight in six poses. Large expressive face, warm orange-red hair, blue cape, shiny rounded silver armor with gold trims, a short blunt toy sword. Always faces RIGHT in three-quarter view. Keep his identity, outfit, body proportions, head size and scale constant across all six poses.
Row 1 left to right: (1) IDLE with sword low in a ready stance; (2) WINDUP twisting torso back with sword raised high behind shoulder and knees bent; (3) STRIKE in a clear forward lunge to the RIGHT, sword arm extended in a horizontal forward strike, front knee bent and back leg extended.
Row 2 left to right: (4) GUARD in a compact braced crouch, arms and sword raised before the upper body; (5) HURT recoiling backward from an impact from the right, free hand on chest and sword lowered, strained face; (6) DEFEAT sitting stunned on the ground, legs folded, shoulders slumped and sword down beside him, comical expression, no injury or gore.
BOTTOM TWO ROWS: the SAME original stocky comical rival knight in six poses. Rounded purple plate armor, red feather plume, large expressive face and a big rounded toy warhammer. Always faces LEFT in three-quarter view. Keep his identity, outfit, body proportions, head size and scale constant across all six poses.
Row 3 left to right: (7) IDLE with hammer low in a ready stance; (8) WINDUP coiling torso back and raising hammer above and behind shoulder; (9) STRIKE lunging to the LEFT with hammer extended in a powerful swing and legs spread.
Row 4 left to right: (10) GUARD compact crouch holding hammer shaft before chest to block; (11) HURT staggering backward from an impact from the left, arms loosen and hammer lowers; (12) DEFEAT sitting stunned with hammer beside him, comical dazed expression, no gore.
Precise registration: twelve distinct articulated poses, not tilted duplicates. Every entire figure including weapon and cape must fit strictly within its own square cell with at least 55px clear space on ALL sides. Standing character body approx 340px high, scale small enough to fit the most extended weapon. Same body scale in all six poses for each character. All feet or seated ground contact aligned to y=450 within their cell. Consistent camera and lighting. No overlap with neighboring cells, no cropping.
Background: real alpha transparency preferred. If real alpha cannot be produced, use exclusively PERFECTLY FLAT PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) with no variation. Never paint a transparency checkerboard. No floor, no shadows on background, no scenery, no panels, no tiles, no grid, no text, no letters, no numbers or watermark. Keep shiny self-shading only on the characters.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original glossy 3D game object icon atlas.
Input images: STYLE REFERENCES ONLY for the strongly volumetric polished rounded match-3 pieces, saturated colors, soft beveled materials and highlights. Do not copy any logos, words or UI screens.
Primary request: exactly TWELVE original object icons on a precise regular FOUR-COLUMN by THREE-ROW atlas. Landscape 4:3 aspect ratio, requested 2048x1536 pixels, twelve equal square 512x512 cells. Each object centered in its own cell, fills roughly 70–80% of that cell, with generous clear separation.
STRICT ROW ORDER, left to right:
ROW 1: (1) a RED short blunt toy sword, red blade and red hilt with small gold details; (2) a BLUE shield, rounded thick silhouette and polished blue surface; (3) a GOLD lightning bolt, chunky beveled three-dimensional zigzag; (4) a PURPLE faceted gemstone, plump broad faceting and glowing purple highlights.
ROW 2: (5) a GREEN poison sword, green blade and hilt with a tiny emerald droplet detail, unmistakably a sword; (6) a ROUND BLUE bomb with gold bands and a short curved fuse, playful toy appearance; (7) a RED rounded heart; (8) a single thick GOLD coin with a simple embossed circle detail and NO text or number.
ROW 3: (9) a RED healing potion in a small round glass bottle with red liquid and a gold stopper; (10) a GOLD relic medallion, a thick round ornamental medal with a central blue jewel, no writing; (11) a GOLD crown with three rounded points and small colored jewel accents; (12) a GOLD five-point star, plump and rounded.
Style: smooth shiny cartoon 3D objects with strong volume, rounded edges, rich saturated colors, soft bright highlight from the upper left and gentle self-shadowing. Objects readable at small match-3 sizes, beautiful polished plastic and enamel / gold materials. Entire object including sword tips, crown points and fuse must remain within its own cell. Same visual size and consistent lighting across icons.
Background: genuine alpha transparency preferred. If not possible, exclusively uniform PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. No checkerboard, no gradient, no cast shadows, no colored tile or plate behind any object, no scenery, no cell grid or borders. No extra objects, numbers, letters, UI, logos, text or watermark.
